structure.unit: Production and Sale of Agricultural Products

text.section:
It is unlawful to:
Sell or offer to sell any liming material unless it complies with provisions of this chapter;
Sell or offer for sale liming material that contains toxic materials in quantities injurious to plants or animals; and
Hinder or obstruct in any way the Commissioner in the performance of his official duties.
Any person who violates any provision of this chapter is guilty of a Class 3 misdemeanor.
